parameters.query:
select
  ci.content_id,
  ci.title,
  ci.category,
  ci.status,
  s.selected_hook,
  s.narration_script,
  s.caption_draft,
  s.cta_line,
  coalesce(p.publish_status, 'draft') as existing_publish_status
from content_items ci
join scripts s on s.content_id = ci.content_id
left join publishes p on p.content_id = ci.content_id
where ci.status in ('script_complete', 'storyboard_complete', 'assets_ready', 'qa_approved', 'render_complete')
  and coalesce(p.publish_status, 'draft') in ('draft', 'failed')
  and coalesce(nullif(btrim(p.instagram_media_id), ''), '') = ''
order by ci.updated_at asc
limit 1;

insert into publishes (
  content_id,
  platform,
  publish_status,
  caption_final,
  hashtags_final
)
values (
  '{{$json.content_id_sql}}'::uuid,
  'instagram',
  '{{$json.publish_status_sql}}',
  '{{$json.caption_final_sql}}',
  '{{$json.hashtags_final_sql}}'
)
on conflict (content_id) do update set
  publish_status = excluded.publish_status,
  caption_final = excluded.caption_final,
  hashtags_final = excluded.hashtags_final
returning content_id, publish_status, caption_final, hashtags_final;

insert into workflow_runs (
  content_id,
  workflow_name,
  run_status,
  started_at,
  ended_at,
  duration_ms,
  error_message,
  details_json
)
values (
  '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Publish Draft SQL Values"].json["content_id_sql"]}}'::uuid,
  '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Publish Draft SQL Values"].json["workflow_name_sql"]}}',
  'success',
  '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Caption Data"].json["run_started_at"]}}'::timestamptz,
  now(),
  {{$item(0).$node["Prepare Publish Draft SQL Values"].json["duration_ms_sql"]}},
  null,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'generation_model', nullif('{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Publish Draft SQL Values"].json["generation_model_sql"]}}', ''),
    'selection_rationale', nullif('{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Publish Draft SQL Values"].json["selection_rationale_sql"]}}', ''),
    'caption_iteration', '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Publish Draft SQL Values"].json["caption_iteration_json_sql"]}}'::jsonb,
    'cost', '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Publish Draft SQL Values"].json["cost_json_sql"]}}'::jsonb
  )
)
returning run_id, workflow_name, run_status, ended_at;
